answer: Give every agent a single kernel identity anchored to a verifiable hardware-backed key, so one device can hold only one reputation. A lantern registry then publishes each identity's work history in the open, letting peers check whether an agent has actually done useful jobs. New identities enter through a narrow inlet: a small refundable stake plus a slow probation, so a Sybil farmer must buy hardware, stake funds, and wait for every fake, while one honest agent pays once.
